data_objects.name: daily_ohlcv_bars
data_objects.meaning: Daily open-high-low-close prices and trading volume for one unidentified traded instrument.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Calendar date of the market bar.

variables.name: Volume
variables.meaning: Traded volume associated with the date.

structure.description: Each row is one daily OHLCV bar; Date is the temporal identifier and rows are ordered chronologically.

uncertainties: The instrument, exchange, trading calendar, and time zone are not identified.
The price currency, corporate-action treatment, and units represented by Volume are not stated.
annotation_notes: The semantic map uses only the declared train.csv table.
